messages:
maria.s: Morning — posting a quick async standup for enterprise pipeline + security asks. TL;DR: MacroHealth wants Private deployment docs, audit trail, and SSO questions. What I did / blockers / today.

alex.h: Did outreach to MacroHealth CISO yesterday, sent onboarding deck + infra spreadsheet. Waiting on network contacts to share CIDR ranges.

cj: Pushed the demo env with VPC peering notes. Saw a config mismatch in subnet tagging — fixed the template and added a note in the repo.

katie: FYI, I left answers to most SOC2 / encryption questions in the sales playbook under "enterprise-security". Still need architecture diagram for their infra team.

maria.s: Blocker: CISO asked for KMS/HSM details and whether we do customer-managed keys. I put that question to security (cc @sam.security). Also need a clear one-pager describing Private vs Dedicated options for procurement.

sam.security: We support customer-managed keys via KMS in Private deployments; HSM integration is a partner option (requires enterprise contract). I uploaded a short FAQ to the security drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/security/pkms-faq

alex.h: Great — can we get a short bullet list (3 items) I can paste in the procurement email?

sam.security: Sure. Draft: 1) Customer-managed KMS supported (bring your key). 2) Audit logs exported to your SIEM or S3 with encryption. 3) Optional HSM integration via partner arrangement. I’ll send as a PDF later today.

katie: On the architecture diagram — I can produce a simplified PNG with VPC peering, subnets, and flow for KV cache replication. ETA end of day.

cj: Demo update: latency numbers for the dedicated pool look good (~45ms p99 for 8k tokens), will add to the one-pager. Need confirmation if MacroHealth requires guaranteed p99 SLA or just average.

maria.s: They asked for SLA language specific to p99. Legal flagged some custom terms; @legal-bot, can we get a standard addendum sample?

legal-bot: Uploaded: /legal/templates/enterprise-addendum-v2.pdf. Note: any custom SLA must pass product review. Expect 48h turnaround for review queue.

alex.h: Action items for today for me: follow up with their network ops for CIDR, send procurement bullet list once sam shares the PDF, and confirm if they need data residency in EU (they do for one of their subsidiaries).

katie: Action for me: create arch diagram + add latency table and secure endpoints section to the one-pager.

cj: Action for me: update demo slides with the p99 numbers and add a short snippet on fallback policy for when Dedicated capacity is saturated.

maria.s: Blockers summary: waiting on CISO network contacts (CIDR), legal addendum review, and sam's PDF. If any of you hear from MacroHealth directly, drop updates here.

alex.h: Quick question — for audit log examples, do we have a sanitized sample log we can share?

sam.security: Yes, I uploaded a redacted sample: https://redwood.internal/drive/security/samples/audit-log-redacted.log. Also included a brief on retention options and SIEM ingestion.

maria.s: OK. If nothing else, I’ll try for a short call with their procurement at 16:00 PT if they accept. Otherwise we continue async. :thumbsup:

katie: :thumbsup: ping me if they want more detailed KV/cache diagrams.

cj: :rocket:

alex.h: Thanks team — will update thread with any replies from MacroHealth.
